scope: Held-out DROID episodes 21/77 ZED calibration v3
summary: Episode 21 completed all three camera calibration/depth gates, while episode 77 stopped on exterior camera 23748752 because the ZED SDK rejected its downloaded calibration under the inherited locale.
evidence: Episode 21 produced a WORKING lineage-mapped calibration.json for three 1280x720, 92-frame cameras.
Episode-21 sampled depth finite fractions span 0.1420 to 0.6837.
Episode 77 opened wrist serial 14436910, then ZED reported INVALID CALIBRATION FILE for serial 23748752 and explicitly requested LC_ALL=C.
lessons: ZED calibration parsing is locale-sensitive and the locale must be frozen in experiment provenance.
limitations: Episode 77 did not complete in this attempt.
Raw rights and raw-HDF5 timestamp alignment remain unresolved.
next_actions: Set LC_ALL=C and rerun only episode 77.
